prs.title: Add owner-reviewed memory beside the existing note job
prs.author: tantalum666
prs.head: cursor/owner-memory-agent-8674
prs.summary:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## This PR

Owner-reviewed memory on `main`, beside the existing note job. The owner saves, corrects, and deletes facts. The model can read active facts and prepare a draft. A draft does not write. Deleted facts are omitted from later model context. The paired display cannot open the list. Base is `main`. This is the bottom of the #7–#14 stack.

prs.title: Add an owner-named folder on the existing computer job contract
prs.author: tantalum666
prs.head: cursor/folder-job-action-8674
prs.summary:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## This PR

One owner-named folder on the same job contract as notes: approve the full text, write only `<job-id>.txt`, independent read-back, cancel does not pretend to roll back. Stacked on #7.

Path gate reviewed: `accept_owner_folder` requires an absolute real directory, rejects NUL, symlinks, and the runtime tree (itself, parents, and children). `JobInput` has no path field. The model cannot submit a path. Writes use `O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW` and a 32-hex name. Owner routes use the owner dependency. Do not widen this while merging.

prs.title: Defer follow-ups during quiet hours
prs.author: tantalum666
prs.head: cursor/quiet-schedule-8674
prs.summary:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## This PR

During quiet hours (default 22:00–07:00 in the workspace timezone) a due follow-up is deferred to the end of the window, and optional text advice is not sent. One scheduler pass creates at most three reminders. The rest wait a minute each. Stacked on #10. PR #14 later stores that deferral so a preference edit is honored. Merge #14 after this one. Do not stop the stack at #11.

prs.title: Explain how to recover a failed computer job
prs.author: tantalum666
prs.head: cursor/job-recovery-ux-8674
prs.summary:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## This PR

Note and folder approval cards name a read-back mismatch, a missing file, an unsafe or unavailable read, and a changed folder binding. The next step is to check the existing file or prepare a new job. The old card stays the record. Cancel before a write says no new file was written. Folder jobs show the first 12 characters of the binding fingerprint. Copy is English and Simplified Chinese. Stacked on #11.

prs.title: Register text providers and job actions
prs.author: tantalum666
prs.head: cursor/text-adapters-8674
prs.summary:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## This PR

`TextAssistant.generate` selects `QwenTextAdapter` or `GeminiTextAdapter` from configuration. Callers do not branch on the vendor. Unknown providers are rejected before a request. Note and folder actions register on `JobService._bindings`. A later bounded action is another row, still using approve, independent read-back, and cancel. Tests use a mock HTTP transport. No account is opened. Stacked on #12.

prs.title: Keep quiet-hour holds tied to saved preferences
prs.author: tantalum666
prs.head: cursor/quiet-preference-8674
prs.summary:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## This PR

A follow-up deferred during quiet hours is stored in `task_quiet_holds`. Restart does not create a second reminder. Shortening the saved window moves the hold. Turning quiet hours off releases only held tasks, still at most three per pass. A future check-in and a snooze stay where the owner set them. This branch also carries the English Codex merge file `planning/2026-10-14/pr-stack-merge-order.md`. Stacked on #13. Top of the #7–#14 stack.
